Dear Valued Customer,

We are releasing an update to CloudTask, version 4.2, on September 15th. This update addresses several issues reported by users, including a bug that caused the app to close unexpectedly when syncing large files, and a display error affecting the calendar view.

In addition to these fixes, version 4.2 introduces a new feature that allows users to set recurring reminders for tasks. The update will be installed automatically for users who have enabled automatic updates. Others will need to download the update manually from the settings menu.

Please note that after the update, you may be asked to sign in again for security purposes. Your data will not be affected by this update.

If you notice any issues after updating, please reach out to our customer support team.

Thank you for using CloudTask.

Company: Fernwood Creative Studio
Location: Portland, Oregon (Hybrid – 3 days in office)

Fernwood Creative Studio is seeking a talented Graphic Designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate has at least two years of experience designing marketing materials, including brochures, social media graphics, and website layouts.

Responsibilities include collaborating with our marketing team to develop visual content, maintaining brand consistency across all platforms, and presenting design concepts to clients when needed.

Requirements:
- Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
- A portfolio demonstrating a range of design styles
- Strong communication skills

Greenfield Grocers is Opening a New Location!

We are excited to announce that our fourth location will open on Maple Avenue on November 1st. This new store will feature an expanded produce section, a full-service bakery, and a larger selection of organic products than our other locations.

To celebrate the grand opening, we will offer a 15% discount on all purchases during the first weekend (November 1-3). The first 100 customers each day will also receive a free reusable shopping bag.

Store hours will be 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM, seven days a week. Free parking is available in the adjacent lot, with additional street parking nearby.

We look forward to serving the Maple Avenue community!
